title: Jacques Vallee publishes his address so witnesses can send him UFO crash parts

tellings.quote: Jacqu Vallet publishes his address online so people who witness UFO crashes across the country can send him the parts

plain: Michels says that the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée publishes his address online so that people who witness UFO crashes around the country can send him the pieces. He tells this himself, without naming a source, while talking with the Stanford scientist Garry Nolan, who studies such material. It would mean physical fragments from these events are reaching researchers through the mail.
